faults.title: Blocked engine-bay drains
faults.description: Leaves can obstruct drains around the engine bay of the second-generation 1 Series, allowing water to collect and affect electrics. Check the drains and investigate any dampness or electrical warnings.

faults.title: Water entering light units
faults.description: Lights on the F20 can admit water and mist up. Persistent condensation, especially with a failed lamp, should prompt an inspection of the unit and its seals.
